compatibility_policy.major_changes: Create a new major schema/API version and retain the previous major until its retirement date.
compatibility_policy.minor_changes: Additive fields may ship within the same major version; consumers must ignore unknown fields.
compatibility_policy.deprecation: Announce deprecation, emit telemetry, retain the old schema, and provide a migration path before retirement.
compatibility_policy.database: Database-facing contract changes use expand/backfill/contract Alembic migrations.
